APPLE: A round fruit that grows on a tree.
BALL: A round object used in games and sports.
BANANA: A long yellow fruit with a peel.
BEACH: An area of sand or stones beside the sea.
BEAR: A large wild animal with thick fur.
BED: A piece of furniture used for sleeping.
BELL: A hollow object that rings when struck.
BIRD: An animal with feathers and wings.
BOAT: A small vessel used to travel on water.
BOOK: A set of pages bound together for reading.
BOTTLE: A container with a narrow neck for holding liquids.
BOX: A container with flat sides for holding things.
BREAD: A food made by baking dough.
BRIDGE: A structure built over a river or road for crossing.
BUS: A large vehicle that carries many passengers.
BUTTER: A soft food made from cream and often spread on bread.
CAKE: A sweet baked food often served at celebrations.
CAR: A road vehicle with four wheels for carrying people.
CAT: A small pet animal that meows.
CHAIR: A seat with a back for one person.
CHEESE: A food made from milk, often sold in blocks or slices.
CHILD: A young person who is not yet an adult.
CITY: A large town where many people live and work.
CLOCK: An object that shows the time.
CLOUD: A mass of tiny water drops or ice crystals in the sky.
COAT: An outer piece of clothing worn to keep warm.
COFFEE: A drink made from roasted beans and hot water.
COW: A large farm animal often kept for its milk.
CUP: A small container used for drinking.
DESK: A table used for writing, studying, or working.
DOG: A common pet animal that barks.
DOOR: A movable panel used to open or close an entrance.
DREAM: A series of thoughts or images experienced during sleep.
DUCK: A water bird with a broad bill and webbed feet.
EAR: The part of the body used for hearing.
EGG: An oval object laid by a bird, often eaten as food.
EYE: The part of the body used for seeing.
FAMILY: A group of people related to one another.
FARM: Land used for growing crops or raising animals.
FIRE: Burning that produces heat and light.
FISH: An animal that lives in water and breathes through gills.
FLOWER: The part of a plant that often has colorful petals.
FOOD: Something people or animals eat to live.
FOOT: The part of the body at the end of a leg.
FOREST: A large area covered with trees.
FRIEND: A person you know well and enjoy spending time with.
GAME: An activity with rules played for fun.
GARDEN: An area where flowers, vegetables, or other plants are grown.
GLASS: A hard, usually clear material used for windows.
GRASS: A low green plant with narrow leaves that often covers lawns.
HAND: The part of the body at the end of an arm.
HAT: A covering worn on the head.
HEART: The organ that pumps blood around the body.
HORSE: A large animal often ridden by people.
ISLAND: An area of land surrounded by water.
JUICE: A liquid obtained from fruit or vegetables.
KEY: A small object used to open a lock.
KITCHEN: A room where food is prepared and cooked.
LAKE: A large area of water surrounded by land.
LEAF: A usually flat, green part of a plant.
LIGHT: What makes things visible to the eye.
MILK: A white liquid produced by mammals to feed their young.
MOON: The natural object that travels around Earth.
MOUNTAIN: A very high natural area of land.
MUSIC: Sounds arranged to create rhythm or melody.
NIGHT: The time between sunset and sunrise.
OCEAN: A very large body of salt water.
ORANGE: A round citrus fruit with a thick peel.
PAPER: A thin material used for writing, printing, or wrapping.
PARK: An open area where people can walk, play, or relax.
PEN: A tool that uses ink for writing or drawing.
PHONE: A device used to talk to people who are far away.
RAIN: Water drops that fall from clouds.
RIVER: A natural stream of water flowing across land.
ROAD: A route with a prepared surface for vehicles.
SEA: A large area of salt water, often smaller than an ocean.
SHOE: A covering worn on the foot for protection.
SKY: The space above us where we see clouds and stars.
SNOW: Soft white ice crystals that fall from clouds.
STAR: A huge ball of hot gas that gives off light in space.
SUN: The star that gives Earth light and heat.
TABLE: A piece of furniture with a flat top and legs.
TEACHER: A person who helps others learn.
TRAIN: Connected railway vehicles that carry people or goods.
TREE: A tall plant with a woody trunk and branches.
WATER: The clear liquid that people drink and that fills rivers.
WIND: Air moving across the surface of Earth.
WINDOW: An opening fitted with glass to let light into a building.
